summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running anything, and nothing is committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs; __all__ = Tab, Tabs; not re-exported from textual.widgets); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges before width and yields one Text with click spans appended last, with the zero-width early path returning before them; Opacity merges blended colors into the existing segment style so click metadata is preserved; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py (appended, existing tests untouched) and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py with tests/widgets/__init__.py. Layout resolver unchanged because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size and fraction defaults. Deliberate deviations: the bar position uses the displayed-tab index, so duplicate names agree with the displayed underline, while find_tab_by_name still drives navigation; letter search applies only to single-character keys; the search flag is checked inside activate_tab_by_first_char. Known limitation: a zero-width label is treated as flexible by the resolver. Tests are unverified; the highest-risk items are the exact ANSI-stripped row strings and the Style meta merge in label spans.
